sequence: Freeze this exact precursor and formation receipt with zero candidates and zero holdout.
A fresh custodian forms a fresh receipt/ciphertext over the exact precursor; G5 secret material is forbidden.
Two distinct independent non-author reviewers validate the exact precursor and holdout under boundary-review.schema.json.
A third distinct independent root validates root-gestalt.schema.json and may ACCEPT only two ACCEPT reviews and zero union blockers.
--pre-author validates all captured bytes once and emits one AUTHORS_MAY_BE_INVITED receipt.
Four isolated H/B/S/D authors bind that exact receipt and manifest; --four-seat rejects any drift before candidate review.

candidate_floor.source_shape: Imports plus one exported initialized const only; no other declaration. The reachable construction graph is therefore exactly the export initializer.
candidate_floor.forbidden: Aliases, dead declarations, local functions/classes, state/src/source access, slicing/indexing/scanners, loops, mutation, casts, dynamic import, constructors, mapState/call/parseState, lazy/recursive graphs, broad remainder regexes, tokens/atoms/component values/CST.

review_gate: Exact schemas and executable semantic checks require distinct reviewer/root identities, independence/non-author attestations, served-model receipts, exact subject/precursor/holdout hashes, three altitudes and all axes, evidence, defects, zero credit, and ACCEPT only with zero blockers.
holdout_gate: Pre-reveal validation binds the complete precursor, status/corpus identity, plaintext commitment, ciphertext identity and AES-256-GCM envelope magic/length/AAD metadata, coverage and anti-duplication facts, candidate/key/plaintext absence, and freshness from all prior generations.
author_receipt_gate: Every author receipt binds served model, admitted manifest and exact pre-author receipt hashes, isolated candidate root and source hashes, commands, close time, APIs, LOC, backtracking, material allocations, compromises, exact lineage input hashes, and isolation facts.
benchmark_gate: benchmark-validator.mjs requires a correctness-qualified source/build-bound run manifest, exact H/B/S/D plus LIVE/deposed/C14 lanes, immutable append-only attempts/raw results, independent statistical recomputation, exact peer keys, descriptive/exits/throughput/allocation evidence, and no retry erasure.
owner_law: After authors, five pairwise-distinct independent skeptics and three further pairwise-distinct adjudicators bind one exact candidate set; all three adjudicators unanimously nominate one already reviewed unblocked hash.
credit: ZERO: this validator can invite authors only after boundary admission; it cannot accept, benchmark-credit, integrate, project, or promote a feature.
